about_the_game:
Welcome to Cardygon, the meeting point for all universes created by Batpolygon, brought together in an addictive strategic card game! Designed as a rich and evolving single-player experience, Cardygon challenges you to master both synergy and collection.

BUILD YOUR ULTIMATE DECK

With over 80 unique cards at launch, every match is a new puzzle to solve. Discover devastating combos, combine the skills of characters from different worlds, and build a deck that reflects your unique playstyle.

A RICH AND EVOLVING SOLO ADVENTURE

Progress through a captivating story mode and feel a true sense of progression as you unlock new card packs every step of the way. But the adventure doesn't end there! Once the story is complete, the real challenge begins with Crossover Mode, offering much tougher and more strategic battles to test the limits of your deck.

THREE GAME MODES, THREE WAYS TO FIGHT

Beyond the main campaign, jump into quick matches with 3 distinct rule sets for endless variety:

  • Classic Mode: Eliminate all enemy characters with the help of powerful support cards.

  • Rapid Mode: The first player to eliminate 3 characters wins!

  • Original Mode: Only your characters matter. No support deck, just pure strategy!

ONE GAME, YOUR PLATFORMS

Play where you want, when you want! Cardygon is available on Windows, Linux, and even Android. And that's just the beginning: get ready for the arrival of cross-platform cloud saves and competitive cross-platform PvP, allowing you to continue your adventure and face players on any device.

SHOW OFF YOUR ACHIEVEMENTS!

Cardygon is built for challengers and completionists! Customize your in-game profile by unlocking unique titles like "Collector" or "Legendary" to prove your mastery.

AN EVER-EVOLVING UNIVERSE

Cardygon is a living game that will grow with you. We are committed to providing you with regular, high-quality content. Here is the game's roadmap:

  • 🔗 Cross-platform Online (LAN + competitive PVP)

  • ☁️ Cross-platform cloud save

  • 🌟 New rarity with animated illustrations

  • 🎮 New game mode (Survival, etc...)

  • 📅 Daily missions and varied challenges

  • 🤝 Unexpected collaborations!

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04, Manjaro, or other modern 64-bit distribution
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD, 2.5 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 or AMD Radeon RX 560 (Vulkan drivers required)
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: ALSA or PulseAudio compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system.

  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system.
